title: Roasted Acorn Squash

items: 1.5 Tbsp olive oil, plus more for greasing the pan
½ teaspoon freshly ground black pepper

steps: Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil for easy cleanup.
Mix the honey, olive oil, salt, and pepper together in a small bowl and set aside.
Remove the top and bottom of the squash, then cut the squash in half, vertically to reveal the interior.
Scrape the seeds and stringy pulp out with a spoon.
Cut each half into 4 moon shaped segments, approximately 1” thick.
Rub the honey and oil mixture onto squash, coating all the surfaces thoroughly and arrange evenly on a baking sheet.
Cook on the middle rack for 25 minutes, or until the flesh gives slightly when pierced by a knife.
Transfer to the top rack and broil for an additional 3 minutes, producing a light golden caramelization.
